name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 19, 2021 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation Declaring National Public Works Week
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 31, 2021 Special Meeting-Closed Session. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-05-19 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2021-05-19 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Appointments to the Youth Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The City Council approve the Mayor’s recommendations to appoint nine (9) applicants to the Youth Commission with terms ending June 2022.
2021-05-19 Item 08C Youth Commission Appointments - Redacted
8D.
Appointment to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy for the Cardiff representative. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The City Council approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Patricia Trauth to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic and Public Safety Commission – Cardiff Representative with a term ending March 2024.
2021-05-19 Item 08D Traffic & Public Safety Commission Appointment - Redacted
8E.
Approval of the First Addendum of the Firefighter Mutual Aid Resource Pool MOU outlining an Engineer Resource Pool Agreement between the Cities of Encinitas, Solana Beach, and Del Mar. Contact Person: Management Analyst Yum
1) Approve the First Addendum of the Firefighter Mutual Aid Resource Pool MOU outlining an Engineer Resource Pool Agreement between the Cities of Encinitas, Solana Beach, and Del Mar; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute the Addendum on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2021-05-19 Item 08E Addendum to Add Engineers to the Fire Resource Pool
8F.
Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2020-21 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2021-22. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
1) Receive final reported outcomes for the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2021-22 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan.
2021-05-19 Item 08F Senior Commission Work Plan Agenda Report
8G.
Board of Community Corrections Proposition 64 Grant: Public Health and Safety Grant Program Funds. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
1) Authorize the Mayor to sign the Grant Agreement with the State of California, Board of State and Community Corrections (BSCC) to receive a Proposition 64 Public Health and Safety Grant; and 2) Approve Resolution 2021-40 to receive grant funds awarded by the BSCC.
2021-05-19 Item 08G Prop 64 Grant
8H.
Adopting Resolution 2021-45 and Rescinding Resolution 2006-39. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Roff
Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution 2021-45 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) and rescinds Resolution 2006-39 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-05-19 Item 08H Adoption of Resoultion 2021-45
8I.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Cardiff 101 Main Street for a community special event. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Approve a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Cardiff 101 Main Street in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report in consultation with the City Attorney to host the 15th Annual Cardiff Dog Days of Summer on Sunday, August 8, 2021, at Encinitas Community Park.
2021-05-19 Item 08I Cardiff 101 Main Street Dog Days of Summer MOU
8J.
Termination of Construction Contract with DB Pipeline for the 1691 & 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Improvements Project (CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the termination for convenience of the construction contract with DB Pipeline for the 1691 & 1711 Eolus Storm Drain Improvements and payment of costs incurred to date of $11,154 to close out the matter.
2021-05-19 Item 08J Eolus Contract Termination
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Leucadia Streetscape North Segment Options (CS04D). Contact Person: Acting City Engineer Bankston
Council to review segment options for the north end of Leucadia Streetscape and provide direction to staff on which segment(s) to pursue with the next construction contract.
2021-05-19 Item 10A Leucadia Streetscape North Segment Options
2021-05-19 Item 10A Leucadia Streetscape North Segment Options - Staff Presentation Posted 0519
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
